title: Fri 02 Oct 2026: FTSE worst day since May, 30-year gilt tops 6%, payrolls day, private credit freeze
summary: The FTSE 100 suffers its worst day since May as the 30-year gilt yield breaks six per cent for the first time since 1998, while Wall Street edges higher as Treasury yields ease. Today brings US payrolls and euro area flash inflation, ahead of the 28 October budget. Regulation: ESMA's MiCA review response, FCA board changes and a calendar of fund deadlines; funds: the Metrics private credit freeze, plus three COO action points and the week's diary.
